title: TRIAD has started
summary: The Horizon Europe project TRIAD started on 1 September 2026. For 36 months, eleven partners from seven countries will study how secondary schools and vocational education can build AI competences alongside foundational competences and learner wellbeing.
body:
TRIAD (Balancing Foundational and AI Competences for Inclusive, Well-being-Oriented Education) started on 1 September 2026. The project runs for 36 months, until 31 August 2029. It brings together eleven partners from seven countries and is coordinated by RPTU Kaiserslautern-Landau in Germany.

The project focuses on learners aged 12 to 18 in secondary schools and vocational education and training. It co-creates classroom scenarios with teachers, school leaders and students, tests them in classroom pilots across Europe and combines the results with neuroscientific methods, to identify when AI genuinely enhances learning rather than replacing it.

TRIAD is funded by the European Union under the Horizon Europe programme, Grant Agreement No 101289995. Public results will be posted on the Outputs page as they are published.
